jury.why: Three model families, no clustering at the ceiling (11 of 14 medians below the available points), every surviving cell carries a hex, pixel measurement, file:line or quoted rendered copy, four of five advisors revised downward against evidence in peer review, no median moved more than +1 from round 2, and I independently reproduced twelve screenshots and eight source files including all four claims put to the chair; the disclosed limit is that B3/B4 rest on code reading plus the gate's reduced-motion probe rather than a running app.

summary: A genuinely engineered, warm, gate-clean build at 84/100 whose one loud defect is that the keepsake it charges $4.99 for is assembled by lib/adapters/ai/scripted.ts — noun-bag titles, ungrammatical bridge seams and a six-string per-mood closer — with floaty onboarding composition, a bleeding sticky top bar and a bypassed radius ladder behind it.
